name: Dempdhpca
summary: UCD0120, also known as dides-B,C-LSD or as 1-deaza-2,3,4-trinor-LSD, is a psychedelic drug and a cyclized phenethylamine and simplified or partial ergoline that is structurally related to lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD). It is the analogue of LSD in which the carbon and nitrogen atoms at positions 1 through 4 of the ergoline ring system have been removed.

pharmacology.text: UCD0120 shows affinity for the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor (Ki = 175 nM). It is a potent partial agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor (EC50 = 7.48 nM; Emax = 63%), serotonin 5-HT2B receptor (EC50 = 22.1 nM; Emax = 64%), and serotonin 5-HT2C receptor (EC50 = 18.0 nM; Emax = 89%). The drug was 14-fold less potent than LSD as a serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist in vitro.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin 5-HT2 receptor agonist; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen; Simplified/partial LSD analogue
